Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉，停止行动！停止行动！
怎么啦怎么啦？我还没找着塔吉多呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Huh? What's wrong? I haven't even found Taygedo yet.

Content.SourceString: 计划有变，我们找个家庭餐厅先开展新的作战会议！
Content.LocalizedString: Change of plans! Let's find a family restaurant and hold our new strategy meeting there!
The Appraiser has to come too! Mandatory attendance!

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅不要胡闹啊，票卖不掉也没关系。
Content.LocalizedString: Haniel, don't get carried away. It's fine if you can't sell the tickets.

Content.SourceString: 不会胡闹的，而且票也会好好卖掉！
Content.LocalizedString: I've got this. No chaos. Tickets will be sold!

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅！演出票派单任务！圆满完成！
Content.LocalizedString: Mission complete! All tickets successfully distributed—courtesy of the one and only Haniel!
Sold out on my end too.

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉呢，不会在噗卡乐园玩起来了吧！
Content.LocalizedString: What about Nanally? Don't tell me she got distracted and started playing at Pukaland!

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅拍了拍娜娜莉 x5
靠谱如本一代目，怎么会贪图一时玩乐，忘记我们的音乐大业呢！已经统统卖掉了！
Content.LocalizedString: You think someone as dependable as the I, the Ichi-daime, would abandon our grand musical mission for fun? Please! Tickets? All gone.

Content.SourceString: 不过噗卡乐园的新过山车确实很刺激！再去坐一次！
Content.LocalizedString: …But that new roller coaster at Pukaland? Totally worth a second ride.

Content.SourceString: 明天中午就在StarSign集合，演出前最后多排练几次吧。今晚好好休息。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's meet at StarSign around noon tomorrow—get in a few final rehearsals before the show. Rest up tonight.

Content.SourceString: 中午见，麻烦明音明天早起开店了。
Content.LocalizedString: See you at noon. Sorry for making you open up early, Akane.

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅呢？不要装没看到哦！今天早点睡觉！
Content.LocalizedString: And Haniel—don't think I didn't see you lurking. No staying up late tonight!
See you all tomorrow at noon!

Content.SourceString: 明天中午，海角广场集合。
好的！明音姐，你不生气啦~
（视频链接：<Blue>「月亮狗之夜」在即，回首音乐流转</>）
Content.LocalizedString: (video link: <Blue>With Night of Moondog approaching, a look back at music through the years</>)

Content.SourceString: 我看到呗果上有人转的，是「月亮狗之夜」往期冠军组合的剪辑！
Content.LocalizedString: Someone reposted this on Bagel—it's a compilation of past Night of Moondog champions!

Content.SourceString: 好几段演出都把我看哭了！明音姐说的上晴塔也看到了！
Content.LocalizedString: So many of those performances made me cry! I even saw the tower Akane mentioned!

Content.SourceString: 太震撼了，「月亮狗之夜」的舞台！我到现在还是难以想象，我们明天就要站上这样的舞台了……
Content.LocalizedString: The Night of Moondog stage is just… breathtaking. I still can't believe we're gonna stand on it tomorrow…

Content.SourceString: T T根本睡不着啊！你们也看看吧！
Content.LocalizedString: T_T I can't sleep at all!! You guys have to watch it too!!

Content.SourceString: 首先，你睡不着，不代表我们也要陪你一起睡不着。
Content.LocalizedString: First of all, you not being able to sleep does not mean you need to drag the rest of us into your insomnia spiral.

Content.SourceString: 其次，今天你就是睡不着，也得给我睡！
Content.LocalizedString: Second, even if you can't sleep tonight… you're still going to sleep.

Content.SourceString: 半夜三更要是让我看到你还在呗果上转发转发转发个没完，你就完了！
Content.LocalizedString: If I catch you reposting videos on Bagel at 3 AM again, you're done.

Content.SourceString: 毕竟是决战前夜啊！可以理解，可以理解！
Content.LocalizedString: It is the night before the big battle—I get it, I get it!

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅发的视频我就不看了，新鲜的感想要留给明天！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm gonna pass on the video though. Gotta save that emotional gut punch for tomorrow, keep it fresh!

Content.SourceString: 不过，本一代目也有一种怎么都静不下心来的感觉……
Content.LocalizedString: Still… even I, the Ichi-daime, can't calm down.

Content.SourceString: 一闭上眼睛，深受信赖的第二副手——贝斯，就会出现在我眼前！
Content.LocalizedString: Every time I close my eyes, my most trusted partner—my bass—appears before me!

Content.SourceString: 它仿佛在控诉「你怎么能睡得着！」
Content.LocalizedString: It's like it's whispering: "How can you sleep at a time like this!?"

Content.SourceString: 放心，明音。我和娜娜莉一起过去，绝对保证她不迟到。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, Akane. I'll go with Nanally tomorrow. I promise she won't be late.
Thanks, Appraiser. Really counting on you.
